ptxt.intxrefpoff: 1st and Reverse Brake Disassembly and Reassembly

servinfosub.title: 1st and Reverse Brake Return Spring
servinfosub.ptxt: Measure free length of 1st and reverse brake return spring.
If measured length is not as specified, replace 1st and reverse brake return spring.

item.ptxt: Do not apply excessive force when measuring spring free length.

spec.title: 1st and reverse brake return spring free length

servinfosub.title: Brake Disc, Separator Plate and Retaining Plate
servinfosub.ptxt: Check that sliding surfaces of brake discs, separator plates and retaining plate are not worn hard or burnt.
If necessary, replace brake discs, separator plates and retaining plate.

item.ptxt: If disc lining is exfoliated or discolored, replace all discs.
If print mark (1) is wearing away, replace all discs.
